title: Extended Journal Publication Opportunities
introParagraphs: Selected high-quality papers from the International Conference on Trustworthy AI and Intelligent IoT Systems (TAIIS 2026) may be invited to submit substantially extended versions to the listed journals. All submissions must include significant new content and will undergo the respective journal's independent peer-review and editorial processes. An invitation does not guarantee acceptance or publication.
